lesson: The forecast omitted Vallejo and leaned on recognizable seeded players. For exact knockout-opponent markets, official draw adjacency is much more diagnostic than generic player strength; locate the live bracket before ranking names.

The 98.5% MQ-4C forecast was unjustifiably concentrated without direct platform evidence. Mission archetype alone is not enough to distinguish related US surveillance drones; retain a substantial branch for the common MQ-9 unless reporting identifies the airframe.

The forecast omitted Brazil after relying on qualitative EV-market narratives. Questions about largest import growth require the current customs or trade table and exact comparison period, not general market prominence.

The forecast over-weighted a high-profile external executive and omitted the chosen board insider. Interim-chair appointments usually come from existing non-executive directors, so inventory the full board before assigning concentrated probability.

Nabatieh was covered at 43% in a close two-city split with Tyre at 52%. The retained uncertainty was appropriate because contemporary warning and strike reports supported both locations without yet establishing a full-city order.

The forecast omitted Brinkema because it assumed a District of Columbia venue. For litigation questions, identify the actual docket, venue, and assigned judge; a broad shortlist from the wrong district provides little value.
